claim: An assumed real equal-and-opposite force pair cancels
assumptions: One real force component and its assumed equal-and-opposite partner.
limitations: Does not prove an interface follows an action-reaction or constitutive law.

claim: Real planar torque is additive in applied force at a fixed point
assumptions: Real planar point coordinates; two real applied forces share that application point and torque origin.
limitations: No geometric differentiation or floating-point equivalence.

claim: Real signed power products associate under an assumed path-rate/moment relation
assumptions: Real force, path derivative and angular velocity; signed force/moment and path-rate associations assumed.
limitations: Does not derive the path derivative, continuous work balance or numerical work.
